title: MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - RODRIGUEZ) relative to providing supplemental funding for the community pet food pantry in the San Fernando Valley in Council District 3.
text:
[Council File 26-1500]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - RODRIGUEZ) relative to providing supplemental funding for the community pet food pantry in the San Fernando Valley in Council District 3.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $25,000 from the AB1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281203 (CD 3 Redevelopment Projects - Services) to the Animal Welfare Trust Fund No. 859/06, Account No. 060052 (Food Pantry Program) to provide supplemental funding for the community pet food pantry in the San Fernando Valley.
AUTHORIZE the Department of Animal Services to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
summary: Transfers $25,000 from a Council District 3 redevelopment account to the Animal Welfare Trust Fund to support the community pet food pantry in the San Fernando Valley.
